docs_algorithm_intro: Weng-Lin is a Bayesian online ranking algorithm published by Ruby C. Weng and Chih-Jen Lin in 2011. It is functionally equivalent to TrueSkill but uses logistic distribution instead of Gaussian, computes updates via closed-form equations, is 2.5-6.5x faster, and is not patented.
docs_algorithm_params_sigma: Standard deviation of the skill estimate
docs_algorithm_key_properties_0: Expected outcome → Ω ≈ 0 → ratings barely change
docs_algorithm_key_properties_2: σ always decreases (system becomes more confident)
docs_algorithm_key_properties_3: Higher σ → larger updates (more to learn)
docs_algorithm_beta_desc: Our rating scale is [0, ~3000] instead of the default [0, 50]. The ratio β/σ₀ remains similar: 200/333 ≈ 0.6 vs 4.17/8.33 ≈ 0.5. The inflated scale provides leaderboard-friendly integer values.

docs_architecture_desc: The wrapper sits on top of weng_lin_two_teams() and adds AG-specific logic. The crate handles the Bayesian math; the wrapper handles game-specific adjustments.
docs_architecture_step1_desc: Asserts that teams are not empty to prevent NaN propagation from division by zero.
docs_architecture_step2_desc: Transforms PlayerMatchData (rating, uncertainty, frags, deaths) into WengLinRating ( rating: μ, uncertainty: σ ).
docs_architecture_step3_desc: Calls weng_lin_two_teams(blue, red, outcome, config) which computes μ_new and σ_new per player using the closed-form Weng-Lin equations.
docs_architecture_step4_desc: See The AG Wrapper Logic section below for the detailed breakdown of each adjustment applied by the wrapper.
docs_architecture_step4a_hint: The raw difference between the Weng-Lin result and the player’s previous rating.
docs_architecture_step4b_hint: Calculates individual performance bonus/penalty using the efficiency metric, comparing the player to their team average.
docs_architecture_step4c_hint: Combines the Bayesian base delta with the performance bonus for the final unclamped adjustment.
docs_architecture_step4d_hint: For winners: if final_delta is too small, it is raised to a minimum floor. engagement_scale = clamp((frags + deaths) / 20, 0.1, 1.0)
docs_architecture_step4e_hint: The final rating is clamped to ensure it never drops below the configured rating_floor.
docs_architecture_step4f_hint: A dynamics variance (tau) is added to prevent sigma from collapsing to zero over many matches.

docs_changelog_v1_desc: Initial implementation using weng_lin_two_teams() directly from the skillratings crate without any wrapper. No AG-specific adjustments: no performance modifier, no minimum delta, no rating floor.
docs_changelog_v2_desc: Added the AG Rating Wrapper with a multiplicative performance modifier. final_delta = base_delta × modifier for winners, final_delta = base_delta / modifier for losers. Performance measured as raw K/D: frags - deaths × weight.
docs_changelog_v3_desc: Replaced multiplicative with additive: final_delta = base_delta + perf_bonus. Performance metric changed to efficiency: (frags - deaths) / max(frags + deaths, 1). Added sigma scaling for faster convergence of new players. Winner engagement floor scaled by participation.
